card.name: Trial words after 'In clinical/premarketing'
card.fires_on: The noun for a study (trials, studies, testing, registration) right after 'In' plus a modifier like clinical, premarketing or standard. It appears in label sections on adverse events, overdose and human experience.

modes.label: Premarketing trials
modes.description: Study noun after 'In premarketing' at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 Human Experience In premarketing<< trials>> involving more than 5400

modes.label: Clinical studies
modes.description: Studies or trials after 'in clinical' reporting findings.
modes.example: In clinical<< studies>>, the elimination half-life of flurb

modes.label: Other study-type nouns
modes.description: Testing or registration after a modifier, or the start of 'preclinical'.
modes.example: 5.9 Seizures In premarketing<< testing>> of paroxetine, seizures occurred in

card.writes: It suppresses the next word being another testing term (testers, testing), so the sentence moves on to the study results.
card.plain: It marks the word 'trials' or 'studies' in phrases like 'in clinical studies' where a label begins reporting study findings.
